title: Piercing Frame Duo #001 (얼굴 컷 · [일반·P8 집중형·얼굴만·메이크업 파키스탄브라이덜글램] ; [일반·P25 집중형·얼굴만·메이크업 텔레노벨라글램])
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, close-up beauty portrait. TWO women side by side, each facing the camera straight on in a perfectly frontal portrait, heads level, both ears of every woman clearly visible, framed tightly from the very top of their heads down to the base of their necks and the tops of their collarbones, the frame cutting off there. Every face is large and sharp. Mid 20s.

#1: A strikingly beautiful adult Pakistani woman — gold-dust eyeshadow, a deep maroon lip, richly detailed bridal makeup, warm brown skin, bright golden-blonde hair styled in two small space buns on top of the head. Her whole face, ears and neck are real living flesh with real pores and fine skin grain, real living eyes with bright catchlights and genuine depth, individual hair strands catching the light.
#1 Piercings: All eight piercings gather on the left side of her face and ear, and the right side stays bare: on the left ear five pieces — a huge mixed-metal drop dangle hanging clear of the neck down to the shoulder, a wide mixed-metal ear cuff, two smaller mixed-metal rings and a small mixed-metal stud at the top; two thin mixed-metal bars pass through the outer end of the left eyebrow; a small mixed-metal ring passes through the left nostril. Each piece carries small amethysts set into the metal.

#2: A strikingly beautiful adult Latina woman — warm golden-bronze skin, a sharp black winged liner, warm terracotta eyeshadow, heavy lashes, strong sculpted contour, large dark eyes with bright real catchlights, a deep berry lip, a fiery, passionate expression, bold vivid emerald-green hair styled in a crown braid wrapping around the head. Her whole face, ears and neck are real living flesh with real pores and fine skin grain, real living eyes with bright catchlights and genuine depth, individual hair strands catching the light.
#2 Piercings: All twenty-five piercings gather mostly on the left side of her face, and the right side stays almost bare: on the left ear eight oversized pieces — a huge antique-brass hoop hanging clear of the neck down to the shoulder, a wide antique-brass ear cuff, three smaller antique-brass rings, two thick antique-brass bars and a small antique-brass stud up to the top; one small antique-brass stud sits in the right ear; four thin antique-brass bars pass through the outer half of the left eyebrow; two small antique-brass rings pass through the left nostril and a thick antique-brass septum ring hangs below the nose; a antique-brass hoop passes through the left edge of the lower lip with a antique-brass snake-bite ring beside it and a small antique-brass ring at the left edge of the upper lip; a antique-brass Medusa stud sits above the lips; a antique-brass labret stud and a small antique-brass ring sit on the chin; three small antique-brass studs run along the left jaw. Each piece carries small diamonds set into the metal.

All piercings: All jewelry is real metal, sitting in real, calm, healthy skin — no redness, no swelling, no irritation — with a small natural warm shadow under each piece. Every piece stays at least a finger's width from the eyeballs, and no chain or bar crosses the eyes.

Piercing depth: every bar and surface bar is embedded in the skin — its middle runs beneath the skin so only its two end studs show on the surface, the skin between them faintly raised over the hidden bar, with a small warm shadow at each end and nothing lying on top of the skin like a sticker. Every ring passes through a small healed opening in the skin, the skin visible through the loop, and every stud sits through the skin with its back hidden. Where a bar, ring or stud goes through the ear, the lip, the nostril or the brow, it passes through the real tissue with the skin wrapping snugly around it.

Pose: each woman faces the camera, arms relaxed at her sides, heads level. Generous spacing so every face reads clearly.

Lighting: a plain seamless deep-charcoal backdrop, nothing else in frame. A soft frontal light on all the faces and ears, so the makeup and the glints on every piece of metal read clearly; a thin cool rim light along the hair and shoulders. 3:4 aspect ratio, 8K.
